limits: This is a source/helper review and synthetic-test result only.
The production bundle/object cache and historical view were not created or imported.
No production source-snapshot callback, frozen replay, qualification, analyzer, or runtime was invoked.

basis: _root_and_gitdir calls _assert_current_graph_metadata_safe before resolving current HEAD commit.
_load_verified reaches ancestry checks only after _assert_current_store_has_no_alternates, which repeats the graph-metadata check.

The helper inspects info/grafts, shallow, and objects/info/grafts in both the per-worktree Git directory and rev-parse git-common-dir; it rejects symlinked/non-directory path components and any present override.
_git_env removes GIT_GRAFT_FILE and GIT_SHALLOW_FILE so inherited environment overrides do not affect the graph checks.

A synthetic graft test demonstrates that Git merge-base hides a raw old merge parent, then verifies the helper rejects the worktree before _load_verified can trust that ancestry result; linked-worktree common-dir graft rejection is separately tested.

historical_source_view defaults only to pinned original-source commit 2991bfb897cad98674efc2feb04388174295e885 and explicitly accepts only that commit or pinned original-core-source commit 328bebab4a60ff10c5a79cd723d44516be2da5fc.
The view-cache path includes the selected commit, and validation requires the view HEAD and sole branch ref to equal the requested pinned commit.
Synthetic tests verify default 2991 source bytes differ from explicit 328 core-source bytes and that the 328 view retains the core commit ancestry/source files.
